name: conditioned ssm:StartSession still fires COMPUTE-SESSION-TAKEOVER
note: A Condition gates the grant at runtime but does not remove the standalone session-takeover primitive; the finding still fires (confidence downgraded by the Condition).
rationale: A Condition on ssm:StartSession is a runtime gate that lowers confidence but does not eliminate the primitive: when the condition holds the caller still gets an interactive shell on the instance and runs code under its role. The finding still fires; no PassRole path exists.
